一般现在时.规则: 表示经常性或习惯性的动作。第三人称单数动词加-s/-es
例句: I get up at 7 o'clock every day.
She goes to school by bus.
We have English class on Monday.
The sun rises in the east.

现在进行时.规则: 表示正在进行的动作（be + doing）
例句: I am reading a book now.

一般过去时.规则: 表示过去发生的动作（动词加-ed或不规则变化）
例句: I went to the park yesterday.
We had a party last night.

一般将来时.规则: 表示将要发生的动作（will + 动词原形 / be going to + 动词原形）
例句: I will go to Beijing tomorrow.
She is going to visit her friend.
We will have a test next week.
They are going to move house.

现在完成时.规则: 表示过去发生的动作对现在的影响（have/has + done）
例句: We have lived here for 10 years.
How long have you studied English?

情态动词.规则: can/could/may/might/must/should/would 等表示能力、许可、建议、义务等

比较级.规则: 形容词比较级：一般加-er，多音节加more；最高级：一般加-est，多音节加most
例句: This is the most beautiful city.
My bag is bigger than yours.
English is more difficult than math.

sentences.en: On the first day of school, a girl with a red bag sat next to me.
sentences.zh: 开学第一天，一个背着红色书包的女孩坐到我旁边。

sentences.en: "My name is Anna Smith," she said with a shy smile.
sentences.zh: “我叫安娜·史密斯，”她腼腆地笑着说。

sentences.en: "Anna is my first name and Smith is my surname."
sentences.zh: “安娜是我的名，史密斯是我的姓。”

sentences.en: She told me she was ten years old, the same age as me.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我她十岁，和我同岁。

sentences.en: Her birthday was on June 1st, and mine was in May.
sentences.zh: 她的生日是六月一日，我的在五月。

sentences.en: She came from Canada, but her family now lived in China.
sentences.zh: 她来自加拿大，但现在全家住在中国。

sentences.en: We both spoke English, and she was learning Chinese too.
sentences.zh: 我们都说英语，她也在学中文。

sentences.en: After school, she wrote her address and phone number on a small card for me.
sentences.zh: 放学后，她把地址和电话号码写在一张小卡片上送给我。

sentences.en: "You can email me when you want to practice," she said.
sentences.zh: “你想练习的时候可以给我发邮件，”她说。

sentences.en: I put the card in my book and smiled all the way home.
sentences.zh: 我把卡片夹进书里，一路笑着回家。

sentences.en: That day I found a new friend, and my world felt a little bigger.
sentences.zh: 那天我交到了新朋友，世界好像变大了一点。

sentences.en: Every Sunday, my family goes to Grandma's house for lunch.
sentences.zh: 每个星期天，我们全家都去奶奶家吃午饭。

sentences.en: My mother brings fruit, and my father carries a big bag of drinks.
sentences.zh: 妈妈带水果，爸爸提着一大袋饮料。

sentences.en: My sister helps Grandma in the kitchen, while my brother sets the table.
sentences.zh: 姐姐在厨房帮奶奶，弟弟摆桌子。

sentences.en: My grandparents always sit by the window and watch us with a smile.
sentences.zh: 爷爷奶奶总坐在窗边，微笑着看着我们。

sentences.en: This Sunday, my aunt and uncle came with my little cousin.
sentences.zh: 这个星期天，姑姑和姑父带着小表弟来了。

sentences.en: He was only two, and everyone wanted to hold him.
sentences.zh: 他才两岁，每个人都想抱抱他。

sentences.en: My best friend Lily came too, because she lives next door.
sentences.zh: 我最好的朋友莉莉也来了，她就住在隔壁。

sentences.en: We played in the garden while the adults talked inside.
sentences.zh: 大人们在屋里聊天，我们在花园里玩。

sentences.en: Before we left, Grandma gave each of us a warm hug.
sentences.zh: 临走前，奶奶给了我们每人一个温暖的拥抱。

sentences.en: I love these days because family and friends make a house feel like home.
sentences.zh: 我爱这样的日子，因为家人和朋友让房子变成了家。

sentences.en: I am a student at a small school near my home.
sentences.zh: 我是家附近一所小学的学生。

sentences.en: My classroom is bright, and my desk is by the window.
sentences.zh: 我的教室很明亮，我的课桌靠窗。

sentences.en: Miss Chen is my favorite teacher, and she makes every lesson interesting.
sentences.zh: 陈老师是我最喜欢的老师，她让每节课都有趣。

sentences.en: My favorite subject is science because I love asking questions.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的科目是科学，因为我喜欢问问题。

sentences.en: Last week we read a book about plants in the library.
sentences.zh: 上周我们在图书馆读了一本关于植物的书。

sentences.en: When I did not know a word, I looked it up in my dictionary.
sentences.zh: 遇到不认识的词，我就查字典。

sentences.en: I wrote my ideas in my notebook and shared them with my class.
sentences.zh: 我把想法写进笔记本，再和同学们分享。

sentences.en: We had a short exam on Friday, and I felt nervous at first.
sentences.zh: 星期五我们有一次小测验，一开始我很紧张。

sentences.en: My teacher said my answers were thoughtful and clear.
sentences.zh: 老师说我的答案思考周密又清楚。

sentences.en: That evening my homework was easy, because I understood the lesson.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上的作业很轻松，因为我听懂了课。

sentences.en: Learning feels good when you can see your own progress.
sentences.zh: 能看见自己的进步时，学习就成了一件开心的事。

sentences.en: I get up early on Saturday because the morning is my favorite time.
sentences.zh: 星期六我起得很早，因为早晨是我最喜欢的时候。

sentences.en: Mom makes breakfast, and the smell of bread wakes the whole house.
sentences.zh: 妈妈做早餐，面包的香味唤醒了整座房子。

sentences.en: After breakfast, I help clean the table and water the plants.
sentences.zh: 早饭后，我帮忙收拾桌子、给植物浇水。

sentences.en: In the afternoon, my friends and I play in the park.
sentences.zh: 下午，我和朋友们在公园里玩。

sentences.en: We run, laugh, and talk about our week.
sentences.zh: 我们奔跑、欢笑，聊着这一周发生的事。

sentences.en: On Sunday, we visit Grandma, who always has lunch ready for us.
sentences.zh: 星期天我们去看奶奶，她总已为我们准备好午饭。

sentences.en: In the evening, we have dinner together and tell funny stories.
sentences.zh: 傍晚，我们一起吃晚饭，讲有趣的故事。

sentences.en: My father says the weekend is the best part of the week.
sentences.zh: 爸爸说周末是一周里最美好的部分。

sentences.en: I go to bed at nine, feeling happy and a little tired.
sentences.zh: 我九点上床，心里开心，身体有点累。

sentences.en: A quiet weekend gives me energy for the new week.
sentences.zh: 安静的周末给了我迎接新一周的能量。

sentences.en: Food always tastes better when someone you love makes it.
sentences.zh: 爱的人做的食物，总是格外香。

sentences.en: At breakfast, I drink milk and eat bread with a little butter.
sentences.zh: 早餐我喝牛奶，吃抹了黄油的面包。

sentences.en: At noon I wash my hands and help my mother prepare lunch.
sentences.zh: 中午我洗好手，帮妈妈准备午饭。

sentences.en: She cuts vegetables and chicken, then puts rice on the table.
sentences.zh: 她切好蔬菜和鸡肉，再把米饭端上桌。

sentences.en: I pour water and juice for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我给大家倒上水和果汁。

sentences.en: On cold days, Mom makes soup, and the kitchen feels warm.
sentences.zh: 冷天妈妈会煮汤，厨房里暖洋洋的。

sentences.en: Last Sunday we made dumplings together as a family.
sentences.zh: 上周日，我们全家一起包饺子。

sentences.en: Mine were not beautiful, but they were the best I had ever eaten.
sentences.zh: 我包得不好看，却是我吃过最香的饺子。

sentences.en: For dinner, father brought a small cake to say thank you.
sentences.zh: 晚饭时，爸爸带来一个小蛋糕，表示感谢。

sentences.en: We shared every bite, and the table was full of smiles.
sentences.zh: 我们分享每一口，餐桌上满是笑容。

sentences.en: Good food is not only about taste; it is about love.
sentences.zh: 美食不只关乎味道，更关乎爱。

sentences.en: My hobby is swimming, and I go to the pool every Friday.
sentences.zh: 我的爱好是游泳，每周五我都会去泳池。

sentences.en: My friend Tom likes football and basketball more than water.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友汤姆比起水，更喜欢足球和篮球。

sentences.en: On weekends we go hiking with our coach, Mr. Lin.
sentences.zh: 周末我们和教练林先生一起去远足。

sentences.en: He says exercise is fun when you do it with a team.
sentences.zh: 他说和团队一起锻炼才有趣。

sentences.en: I am not fast, but I never stop before the end.
sentences.zh: 我游得不快，但从来不会在终点前停下。

sentences.en: Last month our team had a match, and I was nervous.
sentences.zh: 上个月我们队有场比赛，我很紧张。

sentences.en: Tom scored, and everyone shouted his name.
sentences.zh: 汤姆得分了，大家都喊着他的名字。

sentences.en: After the match, we sat under a tree and drew pictures.
sentences.zh: 比赛后，我们坐在树下画画。

sentences.en: I like reading and music, too, because they calm me down.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢阅读和音乐，因为它们能让我平静下来。

sentences.en: A hobby gives you something to look forward to every week.
sentences.zh: 爱好让你每一周都有所期待。

sentences.en: Our body is like a small garden that needs daily care.
sentences.zh: 我们的身体像一座需要每天照料的小花园。

sentences.en: I use my eyes to read and my ears to hear my friends.
sentences.zh: 我用眼睛阅读，用耳朵听朋友说话。

sentences.en: My nose knows the smell of breakfast before I open my eyes.
sentences.zh: 我还没睁开眼睛，鼻子就闻到了早餐的香味。

sentences.en: I brush my teeth every morning so they stay strong.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上刷牙，让牙齿保持坚固。

sentences.en: I wash my hands before meals and after playing outside.
sentences.zh: 饭前和在外面玩过之后，我都会洗手。

sentences.en: My hair is short, and my legs are strong from running.
sentences.zh: 我的头发短短的，双腿因为跑步而结实。

sentences.en: Last winter I was sick and had a fever.
sentences.zh: 去年冬天我生病了，还发着烧。

sentences.en: The doctor checked my head and gave me medicine.
sentences.zh: 医生检查了我的头，给我开了药。

sentences.en: She said rest and healthy food are the best medicine.
sentences.zh: 她说休息和健康的食物才是最好的药。

sentences.en: Now I sleep early and drink water, and I feel energetic every day.
sentences.zh: 现在我早睡、多喝水，每天都精力充沛。

sentences.en: When you care for your body, it takes care of you.
sentences.zh: 你照顾好身体，身体也会照顾你。

sentences.en: Clothes tell a little story about the weather and our plans.
sentences.zh: 衣服会讲一点关于天气和计划的小故事。

sentences.en: Today I wear a T-shirt and jeans because it is warm.
sentences.zh: 今天天气暖和，我穿着T恤和牛仔裤。

sentences.en: In winter I need a coat, a scarf, and warm gloves.
sentences.zh: 冬天我需要外套、围巾和保暖的手套。

sentences.en: Last Saturday Mom and I went to a shop near the market.
sentences.zh: 上周六，我和妈妈去了市场附近的一家商店。

sentences.en: I tried a blue coat, but the size was too large.
sentences.zh: 我试了一件蓝色外套，可是尺码太大了。

sentences.en: Then I found a smaller one with a nice price.
sentences.zh: 后来我找到一件小一些的，价格也很合适。

sentences.en: The shop gave us a discount, so Mom bought it for me.
sentences.zh: 商店给了我们折扣，妈妈就把它买给了我。

sentences.en: I also got new shoes, socks, and a yellow hat.
sentences.zh: 我还买了新鞋、袜子和一顶黄色的帽子。

sentences.en: On the way home, I wore the scarf and felt like spring.
sentences.zh: 回家的路上，我围着围巾，感觉像春天一样。

sentences.en: Shopping with Mom is not only about buying things.
sentences.zh: 和妈妈一起购物，不只是买东西。

sentences.en: It is about walking together and talking all the way.
sentences.zh: 而是一路并肩走着、聊着。

sentences.en: Travel always makes me curious about the road ahead.
sentences.zh: 旅行总让我对前方的路充满好奇。

sentences.en: On school days I go by bus, and the driver knows my name.
sentences.zh: 上学日我坐公交车，司机知道我的名字。

sentences.en: My father drives a car to work along the busy road.
sentences.zh: 爸爸沿着繁忙的道路开车去上班。

sentences.en: On weekends I ride my bike in the park.
sentences.zh: 周末我在公园里骑自行车。

sentences.en: Last summer we took a train to visit my grandparents.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，我们坐火车去看爷爷奶奶。

sentences.en: At the station, father bought the tickets while I watched the map.
sentences.zh: 在车站，爸爸买票，我看着地图。

sentences.en: As a passenger, I had a window seat and watched the fields.
sentences.zh: 作为乘客，我坐在靠窗的位置，望着田野。

sentences.en: The journey was long, but we talked and laughed the whole way.
sentences.zh: 旅程很长，但我们一路说笑。

sentences.en: When we go far away, we take a plane from the airport.
sentences.zh: 去很远的地方时，我们会从机场坐飞机。

sentences.en: I like every kind of transport, but the best part is who travels with me.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢每一种交通工具，但最美好的是同行的人。

sentences.en: Our house is not big, but it feels warm when I open the door.
sentences.zh: 我们的房子不大，但一打开门就暖暖的。

sentences.en: My bedroom is small, with a bed, a desk, and a window.
sentences.zh: 我的卧室很小，有一张床、一张桌子和一扇窗。

sentences.en: In the morning, light comes through the window and wakes me.
sentences.zh: 早晨，光透过窗户照进来叫醒我。

sentences.en: We have a living room with a soft sofa and a round table.
sentences.zh: 我们有一间客厅，里面放着柔软的沙发和圆桌。

sentences.en: Mother cooks in the kitchen, and I like to sit nearby.
sentences.zh: 妈妈在厨房做饭，我喜欢坐在旁边。

sentences.en: After dinner, I help clean the bathroom and put everything in order.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后，我帮忙打扫浴室，把一切整理好。

sentences.en: Behind the house there is a little garden with flowers.
sentences.zh: 房子后面有一个种着花的小花园。

sentences.en: In summer I open the window and smell them.
sentences.zh: 夏天我打开窗户，就能闻到花香。

sentences.en: Grandma says a house becomes a home when people share it.
sentences.zh: 奶奶说，有人分享，房子才会成为家。

sentences.en: I think she is right, because every room holds a memory.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她说得对，因为每个房间都装着一段回忆。

sentences.en: Last Friday was Jobs Day at our school.
sentences.zh: 上周五是我们学校的职业日。

sentences.en: My father is a doctor, and he works in a hospital.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸是医生，在医院工作。

sentences.en: He told us how he helps sick children feel safe.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，他怎样让生病的小朋友安心。

sentences.en: My mother is a teacher, and she works in a school nearby.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈是老师，在附近的一所学校工作。

sentences.en: Her students say she makes difficult things easy.
sentences.zh: 她的学生说，她能把难懂的东西讲得简单。

sentences.en: My uncle is a driver, and he drives a bus every morning.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔是司机，每天早上开公交车。

sentences.en: My aunt works in an office as a manager.
sentences.zh: 我姑姑在办公室当经理。

sentences.en: She said her team helps every customer with a smile.
sentences.zh: 她说她的团队微笑着帮助每一位顾客。

sentences.en: I want to be a teacher when I grow up, like my mother.
sentences.zh: 我长大后想成为老师，像妈妈一样。

sentences.en: Every job has its own story, and every worker has a role.
sentences.zh: 每份工作都有自己的故事，每个劳动者都有自己的角色。

sentences.en: I love nature, and the best place is the river near my home.
sentences.zh: 我热爱大自然，最美的地方是家附近的小河。

sentences.en: In spring, flowers come out in the garden and along the path.
sentences.zh: 春天，花园里和小路边都开出了花。

sentences.en: The sun makes the water shine, and the sky looks very blue.
sentences.zh: 阳光让水面闪闪发亮，天空格外蓝。

sentences.en: In summer we climb the small mountain behind the forest.
sentences.zh: 夏天我们爬森林后面的小山。

sentences.en: The forest is full of birds, and the air smells clean.
sentences.zh: 森林里有许多鸟，空气闻起来很清新。

sentences.en: After rain, the river runs faster and the stones look new.
sentences.zh: 雨后河水流得更急，石头也像新的一样。

sentences.en: Last month our class went there to clean the bank.
sentences.zh: 上个月我们班去那里清理河岸。

sentences.en: We picked up waste and put it in bags.
sentences.zh: 我们捡起废弃物，装进袋子里。

sentences.en: Our teacher said, "We must protect our environment."
sentences.zh: 老师说：“我们必须保护环境。”

sentences.en: On the way home, I saw the sea far away and felt small but happy.
sentences.zh: 回家路上，我看见远处的大海，觉得自己很渺小，却很快乐。

sentences.en: Nature gives us so much, and we should give something back.
sentences.zh: 自然给予我们这么多，我们也该回报它。
